observations: Multiple white gas cylinders stacked outdoors on dirt ground.
The interior of the valve stems is painted blue in several cylinders.
The exterior of the cylinders shows significant rust and surface wear.
No brand names, capacity markings, or test certificates are visible on the cylinders in the photo.

claims.evidence: The photo shows cylinders, but the gas type (CO2) is not confirmed by markings.
The photo shows the exterior; the presence of gas cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be expired or past their re-test date, making them unsafe.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the cylinder shroud.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be empty or contain a different gas than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder markings showing the gas type and weight.

risks.risk: The valve condition is unknown; rust or damage could be present.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve and the blue-painted interior.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped markings on the cylinder shroud showing the weight and expiry date.
Photo of the valve and the blue-painted interior of the valve stem.
Photo of the cylinder while lying on its side to check for cracks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
